stops.name: aurora — the AI's first painting
stops.campfire: Berry asked the AI to paint what the membrane looks like from the outside. this is what it saw.
stops.teach: art is compression. the aurora compresses the whole ecosystem into one image.

stops.name: easel — watch Berry paint
stops.campfire: the chipmunk paints what it sees. not what it thinks. there's a difference.
stops.teach: observation without interpretation is the hardest skill. Berry practices by painting.

stops.name: desk — 12 panels
stops.campfire: 12 panels. each one watches a different part of the membrane. Berry cycles through them like a night watchman.
stops.teach: attention is finite. 12 panels is the maximum you can monitor before you start missing things.

stops.name: globe — geographic footprint
stops.campfire: 93,000 humans visited from every continent. the signal travels at light speed. the meaning takes longer.
stops.teach: geography is not topology. two nodes can be close in network hops but far in miles. the membrane doesn't care about distance.

stops.name: weather — the sun writes the score
stops.campfire: the sun doesn't know it's making music. but if you map temperature to frequency and wind to rhythm... it sings.
stops.teach: sonification turns data you can't see into sound you can feel. the membrane listens to everything.

stops.name: hot springs — validation
stops.campfire: 9 springs. 175+ papers reproduced. 98,955 tests. if it's not tested, it's not science. it's a story.
stops.teach: validation is not verification. verification checks the code. validation checks the claim against reality.

stops.name: try the tech — engineer invitation
stops.campfire: if you're an engineer and this interests you... just clone it. cargo build. see what happens.
stops.teach: sovereign means you own it. not 'you rent it.' you OWN it. on YOUR hardware. forever.

stops.name: banana test — are you human?
stops.campfire: the test fires at π×1000 + random(1414) milliseconds. if you're still here when it fires... you might be real.
stops.teach: self/non-self discrimination is the oldest immune function. 3.5 billion years old. we just put it in JavaScript.

stops.name: protein structure in Pure Rust
stops.campfire: AlphaFold revolutionized biology. but you need Google's cloud to run it. we're building the same thing on your hardware.
stops.teach: protein folding is the bridge between chemistry and biology. the fold IS the function.

stops.name: helixVision — sovereign protein structure
stops.campfire: AlphaFold needs a $15,000 NVIDIA GPU. helixVision runs on a Steam Deck. same physics, different economics.
stops.teach: protein folding is a search problem. the search space is astronomical. the trick is knowing where NOT to look.

stops.name: sporePrint — 117 research papers
stops.campfire: 122 papers. each one is a seed. some grew into trees. some are still germinating.
stops.teach: science is not the paper. science is the PREDICTION the paper makes. the paper is just the receipt.

stops.name: the trail — all 122 papers
stops.campfire: 122 papers. started with bacteria talking to each other. ended with the membrane being alive.
stops.teach: every paper falsifies or extends the one before. the chain IS the proof.

stops.name: detroit — public money investigation
stops.campfire: 341 entities. 131,322 connections. charter school money in Detroit. the machines found patterns. the humans have to decide what they mean.
stops.teach: tuebor means 'I will defend.' the defense IS the record.

stops.name: HUD — Human Universe Display
stops.campfire: game designers figured this out first. health, radar, compass — projected on the viewport without blocking the view. same pattern.
stops.teach: the HUD shows membrane state. not YOUR state. you are the observer, not the observed.

stops.name: getting started — sovereign scientific computing
stops.campfire: one language. one build system. any GPU vendor. your hardware. that's the whole pitch.
stops.teach: cargo build. that's it. no Docker. no Kubernetes. no cloud account. just Rust.

stops.name: wAtER — the watering hole
stops.campfire: this is where everybody arrives. the river carries you. don't fight the current.
stops.teach: the membrane has no login. your identity is how you MOVE through it, not what you type.

stops.name: WebGPU vs CUDA — why we left NVIDIA
stops.campfire: an AMD 7900 XTX costs $900. an A100 costs $15,000. the AMD gets 70-90% of the A100's performance. do the math.
stops.teach: vendor lock-in is a tax on curiosity. WGSL runs on any GPU. your science shouldn't depend on one company.

stops.name: Klein bottle — topology
stops.campfire: a Klein bottle has no inside or outside. pour water in and it comes out where you poured it. the membrane is a Klein bottle.
stops.teach: cis and trans are the same surface. you're already inside. you were always inside.

stops.name: GitHub — 30+ Rust crates
stops.campfire: 30+ crates. 16 primals. 3.6 million lines. all AGPL-3.0. if you use it, your users get the source.
stops.teach: copyleft is not restriction. copyleft is propagation. the license travels with the knowledge.

stops.name: 86 tools — the IDE is a HUD
stops.campfire: 86 tools. all Rust. the IDE itself is a membrane surface. you're looking through it right now.
stops.teach: the tool shapes the hand that holds it. choose tools that shape you toward sovereignty.
